name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct FlixCloud MKV downloads, preserves both HD-2 mirrors, and identifies shared SUB+DUB files as Dual Audio + Subs while keeping SUB-only and DUB-only files correctly labeled.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME direct-download behavior

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: Unified WCOStream-first provider for anime and Western animation. Searches the healthy WCO catalog mirrors, keeps WCOStream/WCOFlix/WCOForever/WCO TV plus language-specific dub/sub fallbacks, supports current and legacy episode layouts and embeds, uses the current video-js-new/getvid flow with fhd/hd/enc quality handling, deduplicates by the resolved media URL, and only marks Dual Audio when SUB and DUB resolve to the same file. Explicit premium-only pages fail fast instead of exhausting the provider timeout.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus rebuild based on current WCO live behavior and maintained AniYomi/Yuzono WCOTheme references
